$comment: AetherFrame's custom Dalamud repository: the explicit, reviewed facts that pluginmaster.json is generated from (docs/CustomRepository.md). internalName and dalamudApiLevel must match the plugin project; sourceRepositoryUrl must equal the csproj RepoUrl. pluginMasterUrl is the address players add to Dalamud, and Dalamud only ever updates a plugin from the exact address it was installed from, so it must never change once anyone uses it. It is the approved GitHub compatibility endpoint (approved 2026-09-27; the refs/heads/ form, which can only mean the plugin-repository branch the publication writes): a shorter branded address may be added later, but this one keeps serving every installation made from it. downloadUrlTemplate names each release's ZIP on GitHub Releases; {version} is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and {package} is AetherFrame-<version>.zip.
